submission.justification: Mixture-G3 with a 2mm gas gap achieves the best time resolution of 0.855 ns among all tested configurations. This represents a significant improvement over the other candidate mixtures (G1: 1.904 ns, G2: 1.268 ns at 2mm gap). The optimization study for G3 across different gap sizes (1mm: 1.072 ns, 2mm: 0.855 ns, 3mm: 1.041 ns) confirms that 2mm is the optimal gap width. This configuration meets all constraints including the environmental requirement (GWP100 ≤ 150) and the geometric constraint (gap between 1-3 mm), while delivering superior performance for the muon chamber upgrade.
